dedupe_keys.name: co udlabs wp6 t61 insa 002 lidar testing data set

description: Lepot, Mathieu at Institut National des Sciences Appliquées de Lyon publishes raw LiDAR observations testing sediment-accumulation monitoring in a stormwater tank through Co-UDlabs. Two drone flights above the Chassieu infiltration tank produced two LAS files, bundled with a report on sensor and test protocol. The source links the experiment to Co-UDlabs monitoring-technology deliverableD 6.2. Coverage is Chassieu near Lyon, France, during May 2023. Zenodo provides two LAS components in a ZIP and a PDF report with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the source describes preliminary sensor tests, not validated sediment-volume estimates; point accuracy, flight heights and coordinate reference details were not inspected. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
